description:
Read the execution prerequisite of an e2e test without running it: a saved e2e test from the .argent/e2e/ directory (or the older .argent/flows/), or an explicit boundary-managed flow_path.
Returns { flow, executionPrerequisite, warning? }: the logical name, plus the precondition its author recorded
verbatim. Empty when none was declared, which is always so for a self-contained scenario: one opening
on a launch may declare no prerequisite, because it builds its own start state.
Use when deciding whether the device already sits where a fragment expects it (correct app foregrounded,
correct account, correct screen) before committing to a run, or when relaying that requirement to a human.
Touches no device: nothing is launched, tapped, dispatched or torn down, and no simulator or emulator
needs booting, so calling this costs nothing but a file read.
Fails if the e2e test file does not exist.
Address the e2e test exactly as you will address it in e2e-execute: name or flow_path, one and only one; supplying both or neither is rejected. The name goes in `name`, which resolves <project_root>/.argent/e2e/<name>.yaml, else .argent/flows/<name>.yaml.

flow_file.description: Path to the e2e test .yaml as readable by the tool-server. Internal: the argent client derives it from project_root and name automatically; leave unset.

flow_path.description: Omit when name is set. Absolute path to an e2e test .yaml on the client. Over a link (argent link or ARGENT_TOOLS_URL), the argent client uploads the file and the tool-server reads the uploaded copy; without a link, the tool-server reads the file in place. Pass the path through the argent client; a raw path that the file-input boundary did not verify is rejected. Pass the same e2e test source here as to e2e-execute, so the prerequisite you read belongs to the e2e test that will run.

name.description: Name of a saved e2e test to inspect from `.argent/e2e`, or `.argent/flows` when it is not there (e.g. "settings-explore"). Omit when flow_path is set.

project_root.description: Absolute path to the calling agent's project root: the cwd it is working in. With name, the saved e2e test is read from `.argent/e2e/<name>.yaml`, else `.argent/flows/<name>.yaml`, under this root; with flow_path, the prerequisite is read from that YAML instead, so pass the agent's cwd.

name: e2e-read-prerequisite
